data.title: Golf Hillside
data.about:
Golf Hillside is a premium residential development in the sought-after Dubai Hills Estate. Overlooking the lush Dubai Hills Golf Course, this elegant project by Emaar features a collection of 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments designed with contemporary aesthetics and high-quality finishes. Each unit is crafted to provide uninterrupted views of the golf course and surrounding villa communities. With its sleek design, neutral tones, and spacious layouts, Golf Hillside at Dubai Hills Estate caters to those seeking a modern, serene lifestyle in the heart of Dubai.

The contemporary 20-level residential tower also features an extensive amenity podium to provide residents with the utmost luxury and convenience. Flanked by Al Khail Road, Dubai Hills Estate offers easy access to major attractions and districts.

  • Finishes and materials in neutral tones, thoughtfully selected for both aesthetics and functionality.
  • The Golf Hillside Emaar project is a cutting-edge development driven by a strong commitment to sustainability.
  • The investor-friendly payment plan allows buyers to pay 80% during construction and the final 20% upon completion.

location_tile.title: Nestled in the Green Heart of Dubai
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Hills Estate is a masterfully planned, prestigious community strategically located between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, offering seamless connectivity to the city's key business and leisure hubs. Flanked by major roadways such as Al Khail Road, the estate provides easy access to Dubai International Airport, popular attractions, and important districts.

Known as the green heart of Dubai, this vibrant community is surrounded by lush landscapes, expansive parks, and the Dubai Hills Golf Course, making it an ideal destination for both residents and investors seeking a blend of luxury living and convenience.

  • Downtown Dubai - 10 minutes
  • Dubai Marina - 10 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport - 15 minutes
  • Al Maktoum International Airport - 15 minutes
